source.source: Gaia EDR3 public TAP/frame_rotator_source spin subset
source.query: SELECT s.source_id,s.random_index,s.ra,s.dec,s.pmra,s.pmdec,s.pmra_error,s.pmdec_error,s.pmra_pmdec_corr,s.ref_epoch FROM gaiaedr3.gaia_source AS s JOIN gaiaedr3.frame_rotator_source AS f ON s.source_id=f.source_id WHERE f.used_for_reference_frame_spin='true' AND s.random_index<20000000
source.source_selection: all returned spin-flag sources with fixed random_index cutoff; no TOP/sky-ordered truncation
source.source_caveat: table subset selection diagnostic, not independent Gaia frame validation
